ownerStatement: Add in the settings an option to Skip detailed cleanup review completely have it also work in Expert mode and make sure when it is implemented it gets be only a one click clean up, and everything should work in incognito.
notes: This record captures the owner's explicit product-design direction in the 2026-08-20 task. It approves implementation of the opt-in design; it does not approve any exact public version, artifact, tag, binary release, store submission, or publication action.
One click means one SiteWipe popup cleanup action after the setting is enabled. Chrome or Brave may still display a separate browser-controlled target-access confirmation for a normal-window run.

Private-window operation remains conditional on the browser-controlled Allow in incognito setting. Under the current permission-lease policy, a private-source run requires exact target access before preflight.
The historical false record in complete-review-bypass-approval.json remains unchanged and continues to describe the retired earlier implementation only.
